intendedObjective: Update the winter tool allowance and loan period.
acceptableEditScope: Only the two factual replacements and grammar they require.
stableFactsAndClaims: Renewals are available if nobody has requested the item.
Return tools clean with attachments; staff inspect electrical items before relending.
Damaged items go directly to the desk, not the return cabinet.
Damage reports do not automatically produce charges; circumstances and normal use are checked first.
Reserve through the catalogue or ask a volunteer during opening hours.
Membership cards remain valid until their printed expiry dates.
authorizedFactualChanges: Eight tools per household becomes six.

sourceObjectiveEvidence.quote: Update the winter borrowing allowance to six tools per household and the loan period to twenty-one days.
Dear Members, our winter borrowing allowance is eight tools per household.
